grants.description: The Community Conservation Partnerships Program Grants provide funding for projects that aim to conserve natural resources and enhance outdoor recreation opportunities across Pennsylvania. These grants benefit local communities, organizations, and individuals by supporting initiatives such as trail development, park improvements, and conservation landscapes. Applicants can apply through the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources (DCNR) website. The program encourages sustainable practices and community engagement in conservation efforts.
grants.eligibility_notes: Eligible applicants include local governments, nonprofit organizations, and other entities focused on conservation and outdoor recreation.
key_requirements: Projects must focus on conservation or outdoor recreation.
Applicants must be based in Pennsylvania.
Eligible entities include local governments and nonprofit organizations.
